sentences.text: Fernando Fernandez, promoted from CFO in March 2025, has driven a portfolio reset: the demerger of The Magnum Ice Cream Company completed on 6 December 2025, with about 19.9% retained for orderly sell-down, followed by an agreed transfer of most of the food arm, some 10.7 billion euros of sales, to McCormick.
Capital returns continued: a 1.5 billion euro buyback completed in May 2025, a new one announced for the second quarter of 2026, and the quarterly dividend raised 3%.
